mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS planned_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.attempt_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attempted_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.send_status = 'SUCCESS' OR r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.read_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS read_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.send_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.send_status = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.send_status = 'SKIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skipped_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.send_status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','UNKNOWN','SKIPPED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processed_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.send_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.send_status = 'SENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sending_num, SUM(CASE WHEN r.send_status IS NULL OR r.send_status NOT IN ('PENDING','SENDING','SUCCESS','FAILED','UNKNOWN','SKIPPED') OR (r.send_status <> 'SUCCESS' AND (r.delivered_at IS NOT NULL OR r.read_at IS NOT NULL)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent_num
mapper.select: SELECT r.task_id AS scope_id, FROM contact_friend_task_recipient r WHERE r.task_id IN #{id} GROUP BY r.task_id
SELECT r.task_account_id AS scope_id, FROM contact_friend_task_recipient r WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} AND r.task_account_id IN #{id} GROUP BY r.task_account_id

SELECT a.task_id, COUNT(*) AS selected_account_num, SUM(CASE WHEN a.state = 'PREPARING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preparing_account_num, SUM(CASE WHEN a.need_send_num > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ready_account_num, SUM(CASE WHEN a.state = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_account_num FROM contact_friend_task_account a WHERE a.task_id IN #{id} GROUP BY a.task_id

SELECT r.send_status, COALESCE(r.error_code,'UNSPECIFIED') AS error_code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM contact_friend_task_recipient r WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} AND r.send_status IN ('FAILED','UNKNOWN','SKIPPED') GROUP BY r.send_status, COALESCE(r.error_code,'UNSPECIFIED') ORDER BY count DESC, r.send_status, error_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_friend_task_account a WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId} AND a.id = #{taskAccountId}
mapper.sql: FROM contact_friend_task_recipient r JOIN contact_friend_task_account a ON a.id = r.task_account_id AND a.task_id = r.task_id AND a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE
